subject: Mutual action plan: assessment materials exchange and cadence for closure
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@atlas-ai.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlas-ai.com>
Date: 2025-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & materials exchange

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week. The eval team on our side wants to get a small set of testcases and a prompt pack to run on our internal acceptance harness. Procurement and security are asking for a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out delivery milestones, ownership, and tight usage constraints for the assets (non-production, no redistribution, delete after completion).

Can you send a proposed MAP and a sample prompt pack we can sign off on this week? We aim to complete acceptance testing by 8/22 and close procurement by the end of August.

Lina
Senior ML Ops, Atlas AI
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@atlas-ai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & materials exchange

Lina —

Appreciate the clear timelines. Attached are two things to get us started: 1) redwood_mpa_v1.pdf, which is a concise MAP with milestones and roles; 2) promptpack_preview_v1.zip, a small prompt pack (10 prompts) and a testcase_sample_list.csv. High-level proposal:

- Week 1 (7/14–7/18): Redwood provides prompt pack + 50 sample testcases and the MAP doc.
- Week 2 (7/21–7/25): Atlas runs acceptance tests on private sandbox; quick sync on failures (30m).
- Week 3 (7/28–8/01): Follow-up fixes/clarifications; security questionnaire evidence delivered (SOC2 summary, audit contact).
- Week 5 (8/18–8/22): Final acceptance window.
- Close: Sign-off + procurement completion by 8/31.

Usage constraints included in redwood_mpa_v1.pdf:
- Assets are provided for evaluation only (internal, non-production).
- No external distribution or commercial re-use.
- Destroy/confirm deletion of materials within 30 days of acceptance or 90 days from delivery if evaluation extends.

If that timeline looks good we can lock dates and share a DocuSign for the MAP and an internal access link to the sandbox. Marissa will own the acceptance checklist and Ben will coordinate procurement terms.

Thanks —
Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@atlas-ai.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-14T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & materials exchange

Thanks Karthik — adding the acceptance checklist below so Atlas procurement/security have a clear play-by-play. Quoting Karthik's timeline.

--- Acceptance checklist (owner in parentheses) ---
1) Deliver: promptpack_preview_v1.zip + testcase_sample_list.csv (Karthik) — delivered 7/11.
2) Sandbox access: Read-only evaluation endpoints + token (Marissa) — target 7/15.
3) Security evidence: SOC2 summary, data handling notes, contact for security Qs (Ben) — target 7/18.
4) Short evaluation guide: pass/fail criteria for each testcase (Marissa) — target 7/16.
5) Mid-eval sync: 30m call to review failures and blocker list (Karthik/Marissa) — target week of 7/21.
6) Asset disposition confirmation: Atlas confirms deletion or returns assets (Lina) — target within 30 days of acceptance.

Usage constraints (short form):
- Non-production use only.
- Do not copy into production models or redistribute to partners.
- Report any data leakage or PII findings immediately.
- If Atlas requests extensions, we will add an amendment to the MAP with explicit duration.

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Evaluation Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@atlas-ai.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@atlas-ai.com>
Date: 2025-07-16T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & materials exchange

Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the checklist. A couple of quick Qs from security:
- Can you confirm that the prompt pack contains no customer PII and that the testcase_sample_list.csv is synthetic?
- We need a retention window of 90 days post-delivery unless acceptance happens earlier; Procurement will confirm exact language.

Also, Procurement asks if the MAP can include a limited license line that explicitly prevents embedding these prompts in derivative datasets. Procurement is cc'd.

Happy to take the SOC2 summary and the sandbox token as the next step.

Lina

Hi all —

Quick status update and confirmed close plan:
- SOC2 summary and security contact sent to Lina (attachment stub: SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf).
- Sandbox token and read-only endpoints provisioned (link shared in Drive).
- DocuSign for the MAP queued: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF-Atlas-MPA. Expect signature from Atlas procurement by 7/24.

Final mutually agreed timeline:
- 7/15: Sandbox live (done).
- 7/21: Mid-eval sync (scheduled 7/21 10:00 PT).
- 8/18–8/22: Final acceptance window.
- 8/31: Target procurement close.

Please confirm if Atlas needs an extension to the retention window; otherwise we will default to the MAP language: assets deleted within 30 days of acceptance, or 90 days from delivery if no acceptance.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
